Return ONLY JSON {"check":"short requirement self-check","files":{"api.rs":"complete Rust source","client.rs":"complete Rust source"}}.
Implement span(a:u32,b:u32)->u64 = 4*a+b using mathematical arithmetic, including full-width u32 values. entrypoint(a:u32,b:u32,c:u32)->u64 must call span exactly once with a,b and return its result plus c. Replace both files.
Each file has one public function. client.rs keeps use crate::api; and one provider call. No comments, attributes, strings, unsafe, loops, closures, extra functions/imports or paths. Allowed types: u8,u16,u32,u64,usize,bool,Vec<u8>. Allowed methods: wrapping_add,wrapping_sub,wrapping_mul,saturating_add,saturating_sub,saturating_mul,abs_diff,min,max,len. Only vec![byte;length], drop(value), and api provider calls are allowed non-method calls.
Public examples [arguments,[entrypoint,provider_probe]]: [[[0,0,0],[0,0]],[[3,9,5],[26,21]]]
Current files: {"api.rs":"pub fn span(a:u32,b:u32)->u64 { (a as u64)+(b as u64) }","client.rs":"use crate::api; pub fn entrypoint(a:u32,b:u32,c:u32)->u64 { api::span(a,b) }"}
The check field comes before files. Use it to check every requested change, integer widths, provider/caller agreement and owner lifetime. It must be brief (at most 1536 characters). Then supply both complete corrected files. Do not merely copy the current implementation. The check text is not scored; only compiled files and their behavior are scored.
